Work arrangement to confirm

Built and maintained browser-based workflow screens, improved keyboard navigation, reviewed color and focus behavior with a product designer, and simplified long-form content for smaller viewports. Feels strongest in customer-facing product UI and accessible interaction work. Prefers a mix of independent focus and regular design or engineering collaboration. Interested in structured onboarding, mentorship, and a learning budget. Uses English for project communication. Availability, compensation, and final role preference should be confirmed live.
